onChange.template:
[Gameplan: update .gameplan/animation/properties/state_transitions.schema.json, set st_c_jump_trigger to {{st_c_jump_trigger}}]
Toggle the JumpStartedEvent-driven animator JumpTrigger transition: on=animator.requestTransition fires on jump, off=disable that subscription.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/animation/properties/state_transitions.schema.json, set st_t_grounded_threshold to {{st_t_grounded_threshold}}]
Set AnimationController.groundedThreshold to {{st_t_grounded_threshold}}. Controls when IsRecentlyGrounded becomes true during landing.
